children: PTT is likely a resilient play in a normalizing energy-price environment, TTB Wealth Securities' Yupapan Polpornprasert says in a note. Its integrated business model, including stable gas and pipeline operations, provides a more defensive earnings profile than its subsidiaries, the analyst says. Together with stable earnings from subsidiary PTT Exploration & Production's gas sales and steady contributions from oil retail, these businesses account for around 53% of PTT's profit, giving meaningful buffer against cyclical weakness. The energy conglomerate is expected to deliver attractive dividend yields of 8.6% in 2026 and 6.1% in 2027. The brokerage raises the stock's target price to 46.00 baht from 43.00 baht, with an unchanged buy rating. Shares are 0.5% higher at 37.60 baht. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
